propositions: A new Pass-1 overlay prompt for concurrency race detection must be authored in src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-concurrency.md following the established specialist pattern with required frontmatter keys (outputs, execution_mode, category, dimension, langfuse_prompt).

The rubric must enforce the lockset-first quartet heuristic as a bright line: shared mutable resource, concurrent executors with spawn points, interleaving window with quoted read and write, and concrete harm; findings without all four elements must be rejected.

Guard-suppression rules must be disposition-aware and structurally verifiable: defer TOCTOU on security boundaries to security overlay, defer load-only concurrency to performance overlay, suppress only when guards prevent the harm not when they detect-and-proceed.
The prompt must instruct Pass-2 verifier to enforce criteria: ["concurrency"], forbid model-emitted severity, and expect empty findings as the baseline (no unverified race claims).
The unregistered prompt file must remain inert until registration story errable-tricksome-ape wires OVERLAY_IDS, routing entry, content trigger, and code-review.yaml dispatch lines.

Structural acceptance criteria require frontmatter parity with code-review-security.md and code-review-performance.md, verifiable grep signatures for concurrency-model gate, sibling-accessor citation, quartet elements, and defer-by-name disposition rules.
